messages:
Jonah: Kicking off staged rollout v2026-09-03 — canary 5% in eu-west-2 now. Holding for 10m quiet per runbook.
Priya: Watching latency + embedding quality. I'll call stop if p95 > 3x or embedding recall drops > 3%.
ops-bot: ALERT: canary eu-west-2 p95 increased 110ms -> 470ms at T+3m. 5xx unchanged.
Sam: Pulling traces. One anomaly: deploy agent reported a partial config mismatch on 2 of 4 canary instances: feature-flag 'kv-prefetch' toggled off unexpectedly.
Jonah: Huh. That could explain cache churn. Any infra pushes?
Sam: No infra pushes. Config change appears to be from a stale template applied during canary staging. Seeing logs: "config-sync: applied template default-2026-08 -> overwrote feature.kv-prefetch=true -> false"
Priya: We shouldn't rollback for a flag flip if we can fix quickly. Options: 1) patch the flag back on in place, 2) exclude the 2 instances and continue, 3) rollback canary. Thoughts?
Jonah: Patch flag back in place, but do it as an explicit canary patch so deploy history captures it. If patch fails, we'll pin region to previous build.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: action request: canary-config-patch --selector canary:v2026-09-03 --patch '{"feature.kv-prefetch": true}' --until 5987690000 --reason "stale-template-override"
ops-bot: INFO: config-patch job cfg-3345 started: applying to 2/2 affected instances
Sam: Patch applied to both instances. Restarted local process to pick up flag. Observability shows cache hit rate improving.
ops-bot: INFO: cfg-3345 completed at 5987654380: 2/2 success
Priya: p95 falling back to ~125ms, embedding recall stable. I'm comfortable extending the observation window by 15m and continuing slow ramp. Update release notes: "Hotfix: restored feature.kv-prefetch flag after inadvertent template override during staging; no rollback."
Jonah: Filing a follow-up to fix the staging template to avoid accidental overrides: INC-8019. Also add a note to the runbook about verifying config hashes pre-cutover.
release-bot: release-bot: annotated changelog: "v2026-09-03 — hotfix: config patch applied to canary to restore kv-prefetch; extended canary hold +15m."
Priya: Thanks. Resuming ramp plan after 15m quiet. Close thread unless regression observed. :thumbsup:
Sam: I'll link INC-8019 to infra backlog and follow up on template ownership.
